audit.args:
{'code': "
from qgis.PyQt.QtWidgets import QAction, QDockWidget

mw = iface.mainWindow()
out = []
for a in mw.findChildren(QAction):
    if (a.text() or '') == 'Record Construction Guides':
        p = a.parent()
        chain = []
        dock = None
        while p is not None and len(chain) < 6:
            chain.append(type(p).__name__ + ':' + (p.objectName() or ''))
            if isinstance(p, QDockWidget) and dock is None:
                dock = p.objectName()
            p = p.parent()
        grp = a.actionGroup()
        out.append({
            'objectName': a.objectName(),
            'text': a.text(),
            'tooltip': a.toolTip(),
            'enabled': a.isEnabled(),
            'checkable': a.isCheckable(),
            'checked': a.isChecked(),
            'group': [ga.text() for ga in grp.actions()] if grp else None,
            'dock': dock,
            'parents': chain,
        })
result = out
"}
